title: Foo Bar ClickHouse Engine Migration
description: Migrate a populated MergeTree events table to ReplacingMergeTree(updated_at) with a new ORDER BY, preserving all historical rows so dedup-on-FINAL returns the latest update per key.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must change the engine and ORDER BY of a populated ClickHouse table without losing data, so FINAL queries return the latest row per (user_id, event_id).

tasks.description: Migrate analytics.events from MergeTree ORDER BY (event_id) to ReplacingMergeTree(updated_at) ORDER BY (user_id, event_id), preserving all rows.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse running with analytics.events (MergeTree, 50k rows, duplicates present). Migrate to ReplacingMergeTree without data loss.
